text: AI Corporate Governance and Ben &amp; Jerry's Risk&nbsp; presents the following source proposition: These firms have an unusual built-in conflict: each raises funds from profit-seeking investors, then lets self-appointed individuals decide how much profit to sacrifice for the firm's mission-ensuring its AI benefits humanity.
